decision.PASS_MECHANISM_ONLY: All hard gates pass; all three pairs lower no-retained-input upper bound; paired median reduction is at least 10 percent.
decision.HOLD: Experiment is valid but continuity is weak in at least one pair or paired median reduction is below 10 percent.
decision.FAIL: Any hard launch, input-evidence, release, scorer-isolation, terminal-score, exposure, or negative-outcome gate fails.

claim_scope: zero-model real-MAP01 bounded-recovery mechanism only; not frontier-model efficacy, human reaction time, general DOOM competence, or general GUI speedup
